user_problem: Browser agents re-pay the full exploration cost (browser actions, model calls, tokens, latency, flaky retries) on every run, even when a task is a repeat or near-repeat of a goal class some prior run already solved (login/form flows, pagination drills, navigation paths) with only rewording or parameter/entry-state shifts.

target_task_class.description: Goal-directed multi-step web tasks on small structured public practice/demo sites: authentication flows, iterated pagination to a target listing position, category/listing navigation and form submission with anchored completion predicates. Three preregistered regimes on matched knowledge bases:

regimes.R1_repeat_reworded: same underlying goal, goal text paraphrased (paraphrases authored independently of the consumer model's family whenever feasible)
regimes.R2_near_repeat_shifted: same fragment classes, shifted entry state or shifted target parameter (e.g., different page depth, different account, different item)
regimes.R3_novel_control: genuinely new goals outside inherited coverage; SPIDER arm must degrade gracefully to exploration without losing to baseline

sites: optional additions from the already-used demo set (saucedemo.com, parabank) only if the affordance inventory proves two sites insufficient — disclosed in the beta prereg before outcomes
explicitly_out_of_scope: category-type goals as primary endpoints (known unsolved failure mode; tracked descriptively)
chains requiring >3 distinct stored fragments (Graph lane's graph-inheritance-scaling program territory; tracked descriptively)
any route/API-capture-replay or registry feature (Unbrowse-class claims are OFFICIAL_CLAIM vendor-run only; Intel cycle-2 reproduction pending)

validated_building_blocks: Cumulative store: states/transitions/fragments with provenance + confidence fields; exact replay reached 0 novel actions on matched routes (Graph G-H1)
Blind content-addressed fragment retrieval with expected-UNKNOWN discipline; cold / verbatim-nearest-replay / single-shot-BFS baselines solved 0/3 composites (Graph G-H2)
Oracle-equalized iterative replay policy carries composed depth at tested depth; login procedure packaging residual value frag 16/16 rows vs graphiter 0/8 (Graph G-H3 E2, audit PASS after repair)
Multi-step login packaging = validated procedural ordering: frag 4/4 login-memory rows vs graphiter 0/4 (exploration-only) vs static edge-unit replay 0/4 with bounce pathology (Graph G-H4 R3)

V31 closed-class descriptor/query equipment adopted as standard equipment for deeper-chain work (Graph G-H4 program decision); used AS EQUIPMENT ONLY — no quantitative retrieval-transfer claim is licensed (fresh instrument spent)

SGDR-style fused task-goal + current-state-summary candidate scoring for free-form goals (Intel cycle-1 clean-room reproduction; audit gate PASS run 32800296360; VALIDATED_USEFUL; claim tier ceiling PROOF_OF_CONCEPT): hard-slice correct@1 36/74 vs task-text-only 25/74 (11 paired wins / 0 reversals) under paraphrased goals + shifted entry contexts; wrong-context-summary fusion falls back to baseline level (24/74); converted into fewer novel exploration actions than task-only retrieval at equal-or-higher subgoal success in the NL-consumer regime (39 vs 42 literal; 36 vs 42 paraphrase). Validated configuration ONLY: lexical-hash embedder, deterministic contract-faithful summarizer, pool top-M=max(3k,20), greedy MMR lambda=0.7. BINDING LIMITS THAT TRAVEL: PoC tier; advantage exists vs task-only retrieval exactly and only in the natural-language-consumer regime (hand-authored exact signatures remain more action-efficient where they exist: 21 vs 39 novel on the literal slice); no login/pager addressing improvement claimed; tiny library/sites; GENERALIZATION language forbidden; WebArena headline numbers NOT reproduced and forbidden in any narrative. Clean-room lineage only (intel/experiments/sgdr_repro/); never copy CC BY-SA reference source.
assumptions_under_test: A1: inheritance benefit survives a real LLM consumer (all accepted evidence used scripted deterministic consumers)

A2: free-form natural-language goals are served END-TO-END by audited fused task+state-summary candidate scoring (with V31 canonicalization as preprocessing) inside the product loop, without hand-authored goal signatures, measured strictly as end-to-end task outcomes. The PoC-tier isolated-harness result does not settle this: embedder/summarizer/scale adaptations and store-integrated behavior are untested
A3: packaged procedures (login-style fragments) deliver measurable savings over edge iteration AND over prompt-level trajectory memory with an LLM consumer
A4: savings are material in tokens/model-calls/wall-clock seconds (perf_counter instrumentation; first-ever cost/latency measurement of this stack)
A5: known failure modes (category goals, deep chains, cross-site) remain contained inside the declared scope with honest UNKNOWN reporting and zero fabricated successes

baselines.B0_cold_current_agent: A mainstream ReAct-style LLM browser-use agent (frozen open framework chosen and committed by the Beta Architect BEFORE any outcome), same backbone model and version as the SPIDER consumer, identical observation/action space, identical step/token budgets, no memory. This is the primary 'credible current agent' comparison.
baselines.B1_trajectory_memory: Same agent + top-k retrieved prior successful trajectories injected into the prompt (AWM-class procedural-memory baseline). Mandatory because memory-beating-no-memory is not sufficient evidence per constitution §13.
baselines.B2_exact_replay_sanity: Exact replay on known routes; diagnostic upper bound only, not part of the win rule.
fairness_constraints: identical backbone model, decoding policy, budgets, observation format across B0/B1/SPIDER arm
the machine-checkable acceptance/completion predicate is disclosed to ALL arms identically as part of the task definition (removes the oracle asymmetry flagged in G-H2/G-H4 audits)
knowledge base byte-restored before every evaluation row; evaluation runs write nothing to the store
site-health gate per row; seeded determinism where the harness permits
paraphrase/goal authorship recorded; independent-of-consumer-family authorship preferred
all SPIDER-arm retrieval/planning/summarization overhead counted inside SPIDER totals (no hidden subsidy)

primary_metrics: task success rate per regime and overall (anchored predicates; fabricated success = automatic failure event)
browser actions per task (novel vs reused split)
LLM model calls and total tokens (input+output) per task
wall-clock latency per task at perf_counter granularity
reused-action share of the action mix
UNKNOWN/false-match discipline events (descriptive; false accepts are violations)

win_rule.preregistration_note: The Beta Architect freezes exact thresholds, panel composition and n in the beta preregistration BEFORE any Phase-B outcome; the values below are the Director-mandated floor that the freeze must meet or exceed in strictness. (Architect v1 froze this floor verbatim plus tightenings 5-7; v2 must preserve both.)
WIN_if_all: success_SPIDER >= success_best_baseline - 0.10 absolute on the full panel including R3 control rows

on R1+R2 rows: median browser actions reduced >= 50% AND median total tokens reduced >= 40% AND median wall-clock reduced >= 30% versus the strongest baseline achieving comparable success (B1 if it beats B0)
zero fabricated-success events in the SPIDER arm
results replicate across two deterministic passes where the environment is static
LOSE_if_any: SPIDER arm fails > 25% of tasks solved by the best baseline
median reductions < 20% on R1+R2 versus the same comparator
win_rule.reporting_duties: Report all regimes and all baselines including losses; negative outcome is a valid product result and feeds the PH-1 disposition decision.

maximum_scope: Internal benchmark harness only. <=4 small public practice/demo sites; ~30-60 evaluation rows total across regimes; one backbone model family per beta version; read-only interactions except the demo sites' own intended forms; compute budget capped and logged; NO production deployment, NO public users, NO commercialization, NO external data sharing. Human authorization required for anything beyond this scope.
kill_condition: Beta stops and PH-1 returns to PROMISING-or-lower if: SPIDER arm loses cleanly under the LOSE rule after one preregistered repair round, OR
two consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID batches occur (infrastructure not ready), OR
a live-site health/integrity incident occurs (pause immediately, disclose, resume only with repaired gating)
A losing beta is useful evidence: its artifacts feed the PH-1 continue/repair/re-architecture/reject decision per the Product feedback rules.
instrumentation_requirements: perf_counter latency capture (G-H4 hygiene: integer-ms floors forbid prior cost claims)
per-row token and model-call accounting from the provider API
store hash before/after each evaluation row (byte-restoration proof)
all raw rows + manifest + analysis code committed with seeds and freeze timestamps before outcomes
